# requirements-test.lock.txt - hash-locked TEST deps for the MOD API image.

# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. The Dockerfile installs it with
# `pip install --no-deps --require-hashes -r requirements-test.lock.txt`.
# Every entry is a SUBSET of requirements.lock.txt at the SAME pinned version,
# so the test install can never move a production dependency (the old
# `-c constraints.txt` dance existed to prevent exactly that).

# scripts/regen_python_locks.sh api (it rebuilds both locks together).
